overview.description: The TrueShares Eagle Global Next Gen Power Infrastructure ETF (PWRZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. PRWZ seeks long-term capital growth by actively managing a portfolio of renewable energy infrastructure companies from across the globe. PWRZ was launched on Dec 8, 2022 and is issued by Truemark Group.
